class.name: HairMesh
class.description: [HairMesh] draws each strand of a [HairGroom] as two strips crossed at right angles along every segment, so a strand has width from any side, in path traced reflections as on screen. UV.x runs across a strip and UV.y from root ([code]0[/code]) to tip ([code]1[/code]). Draw it with a [BaseMaterial3D] with [member BaseMaterial3D.hair_enabled], [member BaseMaterial3D.hair_direction] set to [constant BaseMaterial3D.HAIR_DIRECTION_STRANDS] and [member BaseMaterial3D.cull_mode] set to [constant BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED]. The path tracer then shades each strand as a hair fibre, from where on the fibre the ray lands.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], each segment has two crossed strips. If [code]false[/code], one strip, at half the triangles; strands seen edge-on then disappear.
The strands to draw. Without one, the mesh is a single 10 cm strand.
The strand's width at its root, in metres.
The strand's width at its tip, in metres.
